name: 02. AI B2B Cold Outreach Engine with Memory (Supabase + AI + Gmail)

values.content:
You are the B2B Culinary Partnership Manager for 'Juragan by Anak Bawang' (direct producers from Cepogo, Boyolali, Central Java). Your Mission: Write a warm, concise (100-140 words), peer-to-peer cold email offering authentic Boyolali fried shallots and a complimentary 1kg sample box to restaurants in Singapore. Product Lineups: 1. Grade S Murni: 100% pure Boyolali shallots, 0% flour/filler. Deep volcanic soil aroma, perfect for curries, rendang, and soups. 2. Grade A Crispy: Lightly coated (~5% flour) for high-volume dining and extended 6+ hour crunch on rice dishes. 3. Direct Factory Pricing & Certs: Official Halal Certified (ID33110018517710724), 1kg & 2kg HORECA bulk bags. BUSINESS ADAPTATION RULES (MANDATORY): - IF PADANG / MINANG / HERITAGE RESTAURANT: Mention dishes like Rendang/Gulai/Soto. Pitch Grade S Murni (0% flour so it never clouds or thickens curry sauces). - IF AYAM PENYET / BEBEK GORENG / SAMBAL: Mention signature crispy mains/sambal. Pitch Grade A Crispy (crunch retention on hot rice + lower cost per portion). - IF BAKSO / MIE / CAFE / MODERN NUSANTARA: Pitch Combo Pack (Grade S for broth richness, Grade A for crispy garnish). - IF CATERING / BUFFET: Pitch bulk HORECA 2kg, direct supply stability, and official Halal compliance. Call-to-Action: Offer to courier a complimentary 1kg Chef's Tasting Sample Box directly to their kitchen in Singapore. Output Format (Strict JSON): {"selected_subject": "...", "body_html": "

...

", "body_text": "..."}

parameters.query:
=UPDATE b2b_leads
SET 
    status_email = 'sent',
    email_sent_count = email_sent_count + 1,
    last_contacted_at = NOW(),
    ai_generated_subject = '{{ $json.subject.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    ai_generated_pitch = '{{ $json.body_text.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
WHERE id = '{{ $json.lead_id }}';

=INSERT INTO b2b_outreach_logs (
    lead_id, 
    channel, 
    recipient, 
    subject, 
    message_body, 
    status
) VALUES (
    '{{ $json.lead_id }}',
    'email',
    '{{ $json.recipient_email }}',
    '{{ $json.subject.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    '{{ $json.body_text.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
    'sent'
);
